nodes.summary: Let $A$ be a real $p \times p$ matrix with $|a_{ij}| \le t$ for all $i, j$. Then Each row and each column of $B_k(A)$ has at most $2k + 1$ nonzero entries, so its row and column sums are at most $(2k+1) t$, and Schur's test gives the bound. No symmetry is needed.
